data.description:
MOSAIC Dataset
	

This repository releases the built-in MOSAIC multi-source motion dataset in the following paper:
MOSAIC: Bridging the Sim-to-Real Gap in Generalist Humanoid Motion Tracking and Teleoperation with Rapid Residual Adaptation  
The dataset is organized into:

Human motions stored in an AMASS-style format
Unitree G1 motions retargeted from human motions and converted to NPZ for training/visualization

It includes motions from:

Optical MoCap (Vicon)
Inertial MoCap (IO-AI)… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/chuhonglin/MOSAIC_Dataset.
data.name: MOSAIC_Dataset

data.name: G1_Dex1_Fold_Towel
data.provenance_notes: Verified via WebFetch of the HF dataset card. Apache 2.0 — commercial-friendly. This is the training data behind UnifoLM-VLA-Base's Fold Towel task.

data.description:
G1 RL Locomotion Dataset
	

Unitree G1 humanoid locomotion RL training data collected on NVIDIA Jetson AGX Thor.

Robot: Unitree G1 (29-DOF actuated, 71-dim state)
Backends: MuJoCo (primary), Newton GPU (experimental)
Total transitions: ~270,000 (combined master)
State dim: 71 (qpos:36 + qvel:35)
Action dim: 29 (all actuated joints)
Format: NPZ (SB3 replay buffer compatible)
Collection period: March 2026
data.name: g1-rl-locomotion
